scientific_integrity: Analytic proof based on exact facet inequalities, a spherical-chamber integral, and local area limits. Deterministic finite diagnostics corroborate but do not prove the asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: Fixed normalized regular tetrahedron and Haar-uniform lines constrained through its centroid. The analysis does not establish the translated-line chord distribution or other simplex shapes. The full text of the 2005 closest historical source was not accessible; priority remains provisional.
title: Centroidal chord spectrum and dual rare-direction limits of the regular tetrahedron
